  AND s.plan_tier = 'growth'
  AND i.id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS paying_customers_count
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'paid'
AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01'
AND paid_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(i.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx.usd_per_unit) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.account_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_paying_customer
FROM
  invoices i
JOIN
  accounts a ON i.account_id = a.id
JOIN
  fx_rates fx ON i.currency = fx.currency
WHERE
  i.status = 'paid'
  AND a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND i.paid_at >= '2026-07-01'
  AND i.paid_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts_with_multiple_subscriptions
FROM subscriptions
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM subscriptions
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(id) > 1
)

SELECT
    s.plan_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS churned_subscriptions
FROM
    subscriptions s
JOIN
    accounts a ON s.account_id = a.id
WHERE
    s.status = 'canceled'
    AND s.cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed')
    AND s.canceled_at >= '2026-01-01'
    AND s.canceled_at < '2027-01-01'
    AND a.is_test = false
    AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY
    s.plan_tier
ORDER BY
    churned_subscriptions DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS active_accounts_with_subscription
FROM accounts a
JOIN subscriptions s ON a.id = s.account_id
WHERE a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND s.status = 'active'
  AND a.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND a.created_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)
     FROM accounts a
     JOIN subscriptions s ON a.id = s.account_id
     WHERE a.is_real_account
       AND a.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
       AND a.created_at < '2025-04-01'
       AND s.is_churn
       AND s.canceled_at >= '2025-01-01'
       AND s.canceled_at < '2026-10-01')::numeric /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)
     FROM accounts a
     WHERE a.is_real_account
       AND a.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
       AND a.created_at < '2025-04-01')::numeric * 100, 2
  ) AS churn_percentage

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id)
FROM events e
JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id
JOIN accounts a ON u.account_id = a.id
WHERE e.event_type = 'login'
  AND e.occurred_at >= '2026-07-01'
  AND e.occurred_at < '2026-10-01'
  AND a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS accounts_with_no_users
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN users u ON a.id = u.account_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND u.id IS NULL

SELECT
    SUM(r.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx.usd_per_unit) AS total_refunded_usd
FROM
    refunds r
JOIN
    invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.id
JOIN
    fx_rates fx ON i.currency = fx.currency
JOIN
    accounts a ON i.account_id = a.id
WHERE
    i.issued_at >= '2026-04-01' AND i.issued_at < '2026-07-01'
    AND a.is_test = false AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
    country,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM
    accounts
WHERE
    is_test = false
    AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY
    country
ORDER BY
    account_count DESC
